title: WOULD YOU RATHER: Pattinson's 007 wears the Omega Seamaster James Bond Edition or a Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control?
hook: Bond's next watch: Omega or Jaeger-LeCoultre? You pick.
why: Second Bond post, interactive. Hook: Robert Pattinson was named the new James Bond on 16 Nov 2026 by Amazon MGM (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/entertainment/james-bond-robert-pattinson-cast-amazon-mgm-film); he has been a Jaeger-LeCoultre ambassador since Sept 2026 (https://usa.watchpro.com/robert-pattinson-named-jaeger-lecoultre-ambassador/), while Omega has been Bond's watch since 1995. Fratello (https://www.fratellowatches.com/robert-pattinson-confirmed-as-the-next-james-bond-no-watch-in-sight-for-now/) and WatchPro (https://usa.watchpro.com/robert-pattinson-james-bond-jaeger-lecoultre-omega/) report the on-screen watch is unconfirmed; label any JLC-for-Bond idea as rumoured. OPTION A: Omega Seamaster Diver 300M James Bond Edition 210.30.42.20.03.004, 42 mm steel, US$8,600 on Omega's US site (https://www.omegawatches.com/en-us/watch-omega-seamaster-diver-300m-co-axial-master-chronometer-42-mm-21030422003004). OPTION B: a Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control Chronometre, the line Pattinson fronts in JLC's campaign; use a steel model with price checked on jaeger-lecoultre.com (do not use the gold Perpetual Calendar unless price is verified on JLC's site). Slides: cover (both watches or Pattinson) -> A -> B -> 'Your call: A or B? Comment below' vote slide -> follow. Do not reuse the exact Omega ref as the cover image of the 22:00Z post if possible.

stop_reason: No price-matched pair (attempt 3). Omega Seamaster 300M Bond Edition (210.30.42.20.03.004) is US$8,600 on omegawatches.com (checked 2026-11-21). Every current US-dollar JLC steel Master Control found is outside ~10%: Q4018420 US$10,400 excl. tax (Watches of Switzerland, Wempe; checked 2026-11-21); Q4018421 US$10,500 excl. tax (jaeger-lecoultre.com/us-en, page about 370 days old); Q4158120 US$14,200 excl. tax (jaeger-lecoultre.com/us-en). Swap tried: Omega Seamaster Planet Ocean 600M 42mm steel US$9,200 (third-party guides only, not Omega's site) vs Q4018420 US$10,400 is 11.5% apart, and the US$9,500 grey-dial price is also third-party only. Not publishable: stopped rather than pair unconfirmed prices. Next step for owner: a manufacturer or retailer price for one JLC steel Master Control Date or an Omega steel Planet Ocean 600M on omegawatches.com.
